description: Repro for beads-sigma-6o3 (folder.items[] dangling ref) and beads-sigma-k2r (formula rewrite when calc col moves cross-element). 3 sets, one of which references a cross-element column. The cross-element set must move to the derived element AND its formula must use [Base/REL/Field] form AND the original element's Sets folder must NOT contain the moved column ID. NOTE: this fixture targets the smm browser tool's buildDerivedElementsAndMoveCalcs; the MCP doesn't have that pass, so when run against the MCP this fixture validates only the basic LOD/Set conversion path (the cross-element move logic is index.html-only per beads-sigma-3d8).
